## Agency Outbound Campaign Sync
Runs every 5 minutes. Fully driven by Airtable configuration — no clients hardcoded.

**Flow:**
1. Get approved leads (Leads table, Approval Status = Approved)
2. Loop each lead → load linked Client + Campaign
3. Validate client & campaign are Active, skip suppressed/duplicate leads
4. Add lead to Instantly using the Campaign record's Instantly Campaign ID
5. Upsert GHL contact using the Client record's GHL Location ID
6. Save Instantly Lead ID + GHL Contact ID back to Airtable and set Pipeline Stage = Outreach Active

**Setup:** select your Airtable base/tables, and adjust field names if yours differ (Client, Campaign, Suppressed, Instantly Lead ID, GHL Contact ID, GHL Location ID, Instantly Campaign ID).

## Weekly Client Report
Runs every Monday 8am. Fully driven by Airtable configuration.

**Flow:**
1. Get active Clients that have a Weekly Report Recipient
2. Loop each client → read all its Campaigns
3. Aggregate Emails Sent, Replies, Positive Replies, Meetings, Bounces + compute Reply Rate & Bounce Rate
4. Build an HTML summary and email it to the client's Weekly Report Recipient
5. Save a record into the Weekly Reports table with the metrics + Sent At date

**Setup:** connect a Gmail credential for the "Email Weekly Report" node.

## Daily Campaign Health Monitor
Runs every morning 7am. Reusable across all clients.

**Flow:**
1. Get active Campaigns with an Instantly Campaign ID
2. Loop each campaign → pull live stats from Instantly (/campaigns/analytics)
3. Load the linked Client to read its thresholds (Minimum Reply Rate, Maximum Bounce Rate)
4. Compute reply rate & bounce rate and compare to thresholds
5a. Needs attention → push fresh metrics to Airtable (Campaign Health/Reply Rate/Bounce Rate are formulas that recompute) + email the client's Sales Rep
5b. Healthy → update metrics + Last Health Check date

**Note:** Campaign Health, Reply Rate, Bounce Rate are Airtable formula fields and cannot be written directly — pushing the raw counts makes them recompute.
